researchLog.note: Imported from the project handoff (research rounds 1–3, Oct 2026).
Round 4: Akerly calls him Major James Reeve of Mattituck, father-in-law of Joshua Tuthill; in-law only.

bio: Akerly ([R4-S1]) records that Joshua Tuthill of Cutchogue (b. 1690, son of John Tuthill Jr & Mehitable Wells) married Hannah, 'da. of Major James Reeve of Mattituck', who died 8 Mar 1764 aged 64. This is the tree's 'Captain James Reeves' (father of Hannah, I282695486799). He is therefore the father-in-law of John's 9th-great-granduncle Joshua Tuthill, an in-law and not an ancestor, consistent with the earlier correction that Hannah married Joshua, not James.
